annotations.title: Get fixes ranked by Google traffic

description: Joins your Search Console impressions with your latest Siteiz scan: scanned pages ranked by real Google impressions, each with its AI readability score and open fixes, plus pages with no impressions (possibly not indexed) and high-traffic pages the scan missed. Use it to decide what to fix first. Needs a Siteiz Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer header).

site.description: Your site's host, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.
